title: Chaand Aur Sooraj
desc: Javed Akhtar tells that today we know so much more about nature to the extent that we have cut off an emotional attachment with it. Do you remember the last time you peeked out of your windows or went on your rooftops to see the moon?

title: Judaayi
desc: Javed Akhtar says we humans are so caught up in our personal lives that we don't realise the entire world is flooded with many problems. We talk about them for some time & then go back to our normal lives.

title: Sukoon
desc: Javed Akhtar says our lives are moving so quickly that the destinations are being left far behind. In this fast-paced life we need to take breaks more often to enjoy the small moments of life.

title: Ghum
desc: Javed Akhtar tells how the path of life can lead you to various destinations and explains minute details about human relations and human interactions. He says that the journey of life is different for all.

title: Duniya
desc: Javed Akhtar explains how water can be associated with various aspects of life. It is sometimes used to explain depth, power & at times happiness as well.

desc: Javed Akhtar says trees have been an integral part of mankind & suggests the use of tree to depict various aspects of life - exploitation, hibernation, bearing fruits of success, hope & companionship.
